value.rationale: A one-dimensional unweighted pendant chain is a minimal natural periodic graph exhibiting a genuine normalized two-band spectrum. At the critical resource budget one spatial complex measurement per cell, the result gives the exact best achievable stability, all energy-preserving sensor phases, and the sharp impossibility onset for bandwidth. This distinction is mathematically motivated by stable graph spectral recovery and is more than a parameter renaming or simple computation.
